_comment: Time-limited npm audit exceptions (ADR-017). Each entry names one advisory and one package. Max 31 days from approval. Enforced by scripts/check_npm_audit.py.

exceptions.reason: No patched version exists (<=1.4.0, latest is 1.4.0). Reached via @expo/cli and @expo/code-signing-certificates (CLI-side code signing); not in the app bundle. npm's only fix is expo@44.

Fix is zod 4.6.6, a major version @expo/cli (zod 3) has not adopted; forcing it could break the Expo CLI. Reached only via @expo/cli (developer tooling on the PC); not in the app bundle. npm's only fix is expo@44.
